name: Marigold
short_description: Bright and cheerful flowering plant that produces colorful blooms and works well in gardens and containers.
description:
Bonanza Flame Marigold is an annual with bright orange-red blooms held above dense, bushy green foliage. It forms a compact, upright habit that keeps flowers visible and evenly spaced in beds, borders, or containers. In our gardens we see it perform reliably in full sun and moderate heat, maintaining steady color without flopping. The blooms open consistently over several weeks, giving a bold, fiery presence in mass or mixed plantings.

This variety holds flowers longer than many standard marigolds and keeps a tidy, uniform shape, providing dependable color throughout the season.

GrowJoy Tip: We usually remove only the oldest blooms to maintain Bonanza Flame Marigold’s full, even appearance without heavy pruning.
